Recruiting board

SB season best · PB personal best, all-time and legal — wind-assisted marks excluded. Move is the season best against the athlete's best before this season, so it is not SB minus PB: most of these athletes set their PB this season, which would read zero. No figure means no comparable earlier mark.

US a ranked mark was set at a US venue. NCAA has competed for a US college, matched on World Athletics athlete id — absence is "no collegiate result in our crawl", not proof they are unattached. The implement is shown where it is not standard: a U18 boy's 5kg shot is not a college 7.26kg shot.

World Athletics publishes no U16 list. U16 rows are U16-aged athletes ranking on the world U18 list, renumbered — a floor, not a census. An athlete can appear twice for one event if they rank on both the U18 and U20 lists. Tap a name for their WA profile.

Source: World Athletics top lists and athlete profiles. Built 07 Aug 2026 07:11Z · 43,360 marks · 27,007 athletes.
